body.heading: Where in the world is Denmark?
paragraphs: Denmark is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Denmark is Copenhagen.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Denmark is Danish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Denmark is the Danish krone.

body.heading: How big is Denmark?
paragraphs: Denmark covers about 43,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Austria.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Copenhagen's Nyhavn canal is lined with coloured houses and wooden ships, and Tivoli Gardens has been delighting families with rides and lights since 1843.
Billund is where LEGO was born. Families build and play at the LEGO House and LEGOLAND, then see Denmark's Viking history at nearby Jelling.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Denmark on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
